main.summary:
AI Native Engineer who shifted to agent-based development in late 2024, focusing on problem framing, agent orchestration, and verification rather than manual implementation.

Over {{CAREER_DURATION}}, delivered 20+ projects across four domains (Education, Healthcare, Clinical Trials, Gaming). Key results: 82% BigQuery cost reduction, 270x pipeline expansion via serverless migration, Games on AWS 2025 speaker.

items: Designed a multi-agent development environment, orchestrating Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini for distinct roles in production software delivery (since late 2024)
Established an AI-generated code reliability framework with TDD, reinforcing test-driven development culture and strengthening production stability across the team
Applied context engineering and harness engineering practices — structuring problems, designing architectural guardrails, and building feedback loops for reliable agent output

Designed Event-Driven Architecture by replacing single-run batch processing with event-based parallel execution, architecting serverless pipelines that dramatically expanded throughput and collection range
Designed a shared package system for multi-project environments, enhancing code consistency and reusability
Established a staged modernization strategy; after phased architecture migration with TDD, maintained incident-free deployments during major release windows
Cloud cost structure analysis and pricing model optimization — significantly reduced costs through read-method migration and architecture redesign
Diagnosed bulk data processing bottlenecks and optimized queries — bulk operation migration, table normalization, and index tuning for major sync and query performance gains

Analyzed recurring deadlock root causes at the architecture level and ensured regulatory compliance — outbox pattern, distributed lock-based data consistency design, CDK-based audit log infrastructure as code

Led AI development adoption by sharing Cursor and Claude Code workflows plus context engineering practices in developer meetings, expanding team-level AI usage (Games on AWS 2025 customer session speaker)
Strengthened knowledge-sharing culture through developer meetings, shared library contribution guides, merge rules, code conventions, and architecture pattern standardization
Established incident response culture — propagated Deadlock and data consistency root cause analysis methodology across the team, systematizing recurrence prevention

skills.description: Multi-agent orchestration-based development, context engineering, AI-generated code quality assurance

experience.description: Mobile game development and publishing company. Transitioned to AI agent-based development in late 2024 for backend architecture design and live service feature development
highlights: Cut marketing data query costs 82% ($6.25→$1.1 per TB) by adopting the BigQuery Storage Read API
Eliminated batch processing bottlenecks by migrating to serverless architecture, expanding marketing metrics collection range 6x (60→360 days)

Led shared package architecture decisions and code convention standards across multi-game projects, deploying NestJS utility (10 modules) + Game Server Kit (2 packages) to 7 projects with automated upgrades reducing deployment time from 3hrs to 15min

Designed and implemented Git-like Audit Log + 3-Way Merge engine to automate balance data change tracking and merging across 6 games, eliminating manual comparison and reducing incident root-cause identification time
Unified data from 3 ad platforms (Google Ads/Meta/TikTok) and improved query performance 97% (18s→0.5s) via table normalization

Mitigated regulatory risk from game probability disclosure requirements by integrating a DynamicModule-based probability package across multi-game projects with a CDK-based audit log pipeline, achieving 94%+ integration test coverage (12 suites, 115 tests)

projects.name: Glider Sheet Audit Log System
projects.description: Resolved delayed balance issue response caused by inability to track data change history during game operations

Version Diff Engine: Dual strategy of incremental comparison and snapshot comparison based on Base Audit availability for cost-efficient version diffing
Shared identifier-based Entity Tracking: Decoupled from PK dependency, ensuring accurate entity tracking during migration, comparison, and merge

BigQuery Storage Read API Adoption: gRPC streaming-based high-performance data reading reducing BigQuery costs by 82% ($6.25→$1.1 per TB)
Optimized DB reads: Normalized 100+ column table into main/time-series/prediction, tuned indexes+cursor pagination (18s→0.5s)

projects.name: AWS Lambda Migration & Event-Driven Architecture
projects.description: Resolved batch job limitations from marketing metrics 60-day → 360-day expansion and serverless transition for batch processing
details: Hybrid Architecture: Prioritized operational stability over full serverless migration, keeping the API server on EC2 while separating batch/job processing to Lambda for workload-optimized resource usage
Built Event-Driven flow with SQS+Lambda+EventBridge, reducing batch time 2h→5m and expanding collection 6x(60→360 days)
Transactional Outbox Pattern: Scheduled and delayed event publishing ensuring data consistency
Lambda Operational Stabilization: Batch Size bulk processing resolving throttling, CloudWatch log optimization reducing costs, build OOM remediation
RDS Proxy Connection Management: Resolved DB connection exhaustion during massive Lambda execution via RDS Proxy pooling

projects.name: Cloud Data Sync System
projects.description: Built S3-based sync and automated DDL management system to resolve dynamic game data inconsistency across environments
details: Cross-environment Data Sync: S3-based dynamic game data synchronization across development/staging/production environments
Automated DDL Management Engine: Dynamic PK column type resolution, column type mismatch detection with MODIFY, and automatic index creation/RENAME for schema sync automation
Save/Upload Performance Improvement: Analyzed and optimized Cloud Data ingestion and S3 upload bottlenecks, resolving large-scale processing delays

excludeCloudData Propagation Patch: Added option forwarding to four POST migration paths to block unintended full Cloud Data deletion risk
